behavior_profiles.purpose: General typed lifecycle with explicit state, transition owner, HOLD, repair, and closure.
Epistemic object with provenance, evidence status, uncertainty, and revision boundaries.
Observed or captured effect linked to execution, evidence, cycle, and state update.
Process or protocol run with declared input, output, owner, route, and terminal status.
Machine-level object with constitutional ownership, interfaces, invariants, and lifecycle.
Authorized action with scope, executor, risk, reversibility, and effect capture.
Proposal separated from authorization, execution, and effect.
C00-C11 or external phase object with gate, evidence, owner, and transition contract.
Trajectory with ordered state transitions, protected invariants, and closure criteria.

special_contract.canonical_definition: A philosophical machine is a substrate-linked reproducible temporal loop of transition rules that receives substrate material, abstracts categories, calculates category transitions through declared calculating elements, concretizes results back into the substrate, records feedback and next state, maintains memory, agency, value interface, risk and closure, and supports authorized changes of its structure and phases.

c07_admission_contract.admitted_when: external_effect == NONE OR (effect_class in SIMULATED,SANDBOXED,OBSERVATIONAL and reversibility in FULL,PARTIAL and risk_class stays below external-authorization threshold)
